title: Concept: Password field allows autocomplete
description: A password input that sets autocomplete to on in a response gives every reader the same visibility the bank has internally: Autocomplete on a password field makes the browser store and replay the credential, which exposes it to anyone with access to the profile and to scripts that read autofilled values.
applicability: A stored credential on a shared device is one profile switch away from account takeover.
risk: The attribute is a direct instruction to store the value.
